files.role: Structural repetition/definition normalization, dense serialization and row budgets, sparse delegation, slicing, Arrow structural reconstruction and full-zip control words.
files.limits: All4083 lines freshly read in bounded ANALYZE80 calls. Source deductions only; no network or repository execution. Full primitive/sparse/list/struct/encoder/decoder callers remain pending. Unsafe proofs, panic and unchecked-input preconditions retained.
ranges: License and conceptual repetition example. Lance numbers from the leaf, unlike Parquet; these utilities do not promise Parquet compatibility. Dense entries include null/empty-list placeholders and can outnumber leaf values. The example final row says start of outermost list but prints repetition0, inconsistent with its own start rule and the actual serializer.

Definition0 means valid; increasing levels indicate nulls farther outward. Parent nulls erase irrelevant child validity. RLE and byte zipping are motivations, not compression performed by this module, and claims of definition compactness assume the described nesting/bit representation.

Module map identifies builder, serializer, composite reconstruction, slicer and full-zip words. Dependencies are Arrow buffers/offset traits, LanceBuffer, bit-width helper, core errors and sparse-plan/unraveler delegation. No IO or async work here. Public LevelBuffer aliases Vec<u16>.

Crate-internal MiniBlockRepDefSplit records relative top-row start/count, dense level range and visible leaf start/count. Budget enum is WithinBudget, RequiresPageSplit(vector), or SingleRowOverBudget(level count); the last is a successful planning result, not an Error.

Private SPECIAL_THRESHOLD is u16::MAX/2=32767, despite comment referring to a top bit. Construction tags invisible specials by adding32767 and recognizes strictly greater values; final normalization subtracts it. Nesting/cumulative definition counts must stay within arithmetic and sentinel assumptions; there is no checked depth validator here.

OffsetDesc shares normalized i64 offsets via Arc and stores optional bitmap, empty flag, slot count and special count. ValidityDesc stores bitmap/count. FslDesc also stores dimension. Optional bitmap presence, not actual null count, determines has_nulls for these raw descriptors.

Private cloned RawRepDef has Offsets/Validity/Fsl alternatives. Crate-internal borrowed NormalizedStructuralLayer exposes corresponding offsets/bitmap/dimension/num_slots views. FSL is a validity-like layer, not a repetition-producing list interpretation.

NormalizedStructuralPlan privately owns concatenated raw layers plus dense_all_valid. layers returns an exact-size iterator borrowing descriptors and maps num_values to num_slots. This representation is shared with sparse planning, whose complete implementation remains pending.

to_serializer fast path when every builder is empty preserves one AllValidItem per layer and emits no buffers/bits, zero cursors and no FSL flag. This fast path only applies to plain no-null Validity layers, not offsets or FSL.

Otherwise reserve leaf-slot count plus all recorded specials, sum repetition/definition maxima as u16, derive inclusive bit widths from leading zeros and allocate SerializerContext. Visit normalized layers outer-to-inner. Arithmetic uses ordinary additions and assumes consistent counts/depth; no overflow Result boundary.

Plan serialize builds dense output; serialize_with_miniblock_repdef_budget calls an FnOnce budget callback only if nonzero level bits exist, then returns dense output plus budget classification. num_rows and num_values are caller-supplied counts used only on eligible planning paths.
RawRepDef helpers report bitmap presence, slot count, and offsets-only special count. These helpers are private and do not validate the bitmap or child lengths.

max_def uses one level for present validity and one for valid empty lists; nonnullable item/FSL consumes0. Every variable-list offsets layer consumes one repetition level. Sums can exceed u16 assumptions without explicit validation.

Public SerializedRepDefs exposes optional Arc-u16 rep/def buffers, leaf-first meanings and optional visibility threshold; private has_fsl records actual FSL processing. Free max_visible_level sums definition increments strictly before first variable-list meaning; no lists yields full max_def. Null items can own leaf slots; null/empty lists cannot.

Associated visibility returns None without list meanings. Public new converts Vec buffers to Arc, computes threshold and assumes has_fsl=false; crate constructor accepts explicit FSL flag. Neither validates lengths, level bounds or meaning consistency.

Public empty accepts any meanings but unconditionally sets both buffers and visibility to None and has_fsl=false. rep_slicer/def_slicer return independent borrowed-state cursors only for present buffers. Crate has_fixed_size_list_levels exposes private flag.

RepDefSlicer borrows immutable serialized metadata, shares selected Arc via LanceBuffer reinterpretation and counts u16 levels by byte length/2. all_levels returns the whole buffer, not the remainder; no compressed-level representation supported.

slice_rest returns all remaining bytes and exhausts cursor. Final slice must use it because slice_next stops at its last requested visible value and leaves following invisible entries for the next call.

slice_next without list threshold or def buffer takes exactly N levels. Otherwise scan defs until N entries are <= visibility, including encountered invisible entries. It assumes enough values and aligned buffers, using unwrap/slice panics; zero request consumes nothing. Separate rep/def slicers must receive identical requests.

Six public DefinitionInterpretation variants encode all-valid item/list, nullable item/list, emptyable list and combined nullable-emptyable list. Their definition increments are0,0,1,1,1,2 respectively; ordering of the meaning vector is leaf-first after normal serialization.

is_all_valid returns true also for EmptyableList because absence of nulls differs from absence of definition levels. is_list recognizes the four variable-list variants only. FSL is represented as an item validity meaning.

Private SerializerContext owns active/spare u16 rep and def vectors, cursors and FSL flag. Allocate two zeroed vectors of full planned length for each nonzero maximum: up to8 bytes per planned dense level before final Arc conversion, excluding inputs/metadata. Spare buffers avoid aliasing reads/writes.

checkout_def returns current cumulative def, subtracts this layer increment and pushes outer-first meaning. record_offsets reserves current rep then decrements it. Combined list assigns null=current-1, empty=current; other list modes consume0 or1 def. Apply list validity before expanding offsets.

record_offsets reads active and writes spare buffers. Empty normalized offsets0 set current_len0 and return. No-def path requires every list length positive, preserves incoming nonzero outer rep on the first child, sets other children rep0 and swaps rep buffers. It assumes exact normalized slot relationships.

With defs, carry higher tagged specials unchanged; each ordinary list uses incoming outer rep or current rep. Valid nonempty list expands first entry plus zero/zero continuation entries, empty valid list inserts tagged empty level, any existing null promotes to tagged invisible special.

Copy remaining parent specials at the tail, swap rep/def active and spare vectors, update current_len and add this offsets layer special count. The vectors retain allocated length; build later does not truncate them to current_len, relying on planned length consistency.

do_record_validity asserts capacity and debug-checks slot count plus prior specials. Skip/copy special tags; replace only a zero definition with incoming null level, preserving higher parent nulls. Copy trailing specials and swap defs; rep is unchanged.

multiply_levels expands current_len by dimension for non-special slots, keeping special count fixed. No buffers returns immediately; def-only repeats each ordinary def, rep-only repeats the same rep across each FSL element. No positivity/overflow guard here.

Both-buffer multiplication carries tagged specials and repeats rep/def per dimension, then swaps active/spare vectors. Loops use old_len iterations even while consuming extra specials in inner loops, an implicit shape/count precondition; do not claim general mixed-list/FSL support from this helper.

record_validity_buf chooses NullableItem only from Some bitmap, otherwise AllValidItem. record_validity forwards it. record_fsl sets has_fsl, records parent validity then broadcasts levels. normalize_specials scans full def vector and subtracts32767 for values greater than the threshold.

Split planner early exits: no defs, no rep, absent budget, zero visible values, any FSL, or no variable-list meaning. Existing defs are normalized on all exits except already-empty defs. If both buffers exist, unequal lengths returns Internal before budget checks. WithinBudget is conditional policy, not a universal byte-size guarantee.

Planner tracks row and page dense ranges and visible counts. A row has overhead iff dense entries exceed visible values. Record over-budget count only for rows with overhead; last offending row overwrites prior count. Greedily split before a row only if current page nonempty, either side has overhead and combined levels exceed budget. Dense-only long rows are exempt from this policy.

Normalize each special while scanning equal buffers. Top row starts exactly when rep equals schema list count. Levels before a top-row start, absent starts, or a first discovered start after position0 return Internal. Count visible defs<=threshold and finish final row. Input state can already be normalized when error occurs; serializer is consumed by caller.

Counted top rows and visible values must equal supplied counts or Internal includes expected/actual. No overhead returns WithinBudget; any offending row returns SingleRowOverBudget before page-split result. Otherwise append final split and require more than one split for RequiresPageSplit. Does not emit pages or choose fallback codec.

build with current_len0 returns absent buffers and unreversed meanings. Nonzero path normalizes tags, returns each nonempty entire vector, reverses outer-first meanings to leaf-first and retains FSL flag. No length truncation/structural validation is performed.

Budgeted build likewise has a zero-current-length fast path with unreversed meanings and WithinBudget; otherwise reverse meanings first, normalize/plan, then package existing nonempty vectors with budget. Error aborts this consumed context.

Public Clone/Default RepDefBuilder keeps raw layers and optional current child length. check_validity_len initializes once then assert-equals. is_empty means every layer is plain all-valid Validity (vacuously true for no layers); is_simple_validity requires exactly one Validity layer, regardless of nulls.

add_validity_bitmap drops all-valid bitmaps through add_no_null, preserving length assertions. add_fsl asserts parent count if initialized, sets child len=count*dimension and only debug-asserts bitmap length; Some all-valid bitmap is retained and dimension0 is not rejected here. check_offset_len expects slot count+1 and stores final normalized offset cast to usize.

do_add_offsets accumulates lengths from zero; null slots contribute no child values and count as specials, returning true if they had garbage child values. Valid empty lists also count as specials and set empty flag. With validity, zip truncates to shorter input; mismatches may only be noticed by initialized parent-count assertion. Caller must remove discarded child values.

Public generic add_offsets reconstructs i64 or i32 scalar views, uses adjacent differences and delegates normalized lengths. Nonzero base offsets therefore rebase automatically. Null garbage removal is only signaled, never performed on value arrays. Existing Arrow offset buffer validity and consistent child lengths are assumed.

concat_layers gathers same-depth raw layers across batches, computing bitmap presence, cumulative slots/specials and empty flags. Layer kind and FSL dimension are taken from encountered inputs, effectively last input; homogeneous kinds/dimensions are documented assumptions, not validated.

Without null bitmaps, plain validity and FSL return count-only descriptors. Otherwise allocate a bitmap; offsets allocate a vector starting0 even with no nulls. Capacity is a hint, not exact storage enforcement.

Concatenate optional validity, filling true for missing bitmaps when needed. Offset vectors append all but initial0 after adding previous tail. FSL bitmap concatenation follows slot counts; no dimension consistency check.

Finish normalized descriptor by selected kind. Public serialize consumes nonempty builder vector through normalize then dense serialization. normalize asserts nonempty, debug-asserts equal layer counts, indexes each builder at first-builder depths, concatenates once and marks all-valid only if every builder.is_empty. Fewer layers can panic; extra layers can be ignored in release.

Public RepDefUnraveler carries either sparse delegate or dense vectors, leaf-first meanings, rep visibility map and consumption cursors. new maps def0 to rep0; NullableItem uses current counter and nullable/emptyable list increments it. Literal AllValidList branch adds nothing and does not increment counter. Inputs are not validated; num_items is caller-provided fallback count.

Crate new_sparse initializes delegate with empty dense fields. ensure_exhausted checks only sparse state; dense state always succeeds. is_all_valid delegates or returns true for absent defs/current all-valid meaning. max_lists delegates or returns remaining rep-vector length, an upper bound, not exact list count; dense misuse can panic via meaning indexing.

unravel_offsets delegates sparse first. Dense requires rep vector and list meaning, advances layer/def counters, identifies null/empty levels, then scans outward through adjacent item meanings to include null structs masking this list. This call handles list validity together with offsets.

Append offsets after existing tail by reading tail then popping it, avoiding duplicate boundaries between pages. T::from_usize failure returns InvalidInput mentioning i32::MAX/large containers even though T is generic. State/counters and destination may already be mutated before failure; no rollback contract.

Dense paired loop asserts equal lengths then uses unchecked reads/writes with read_idx<len and write_idx<=read_idx. Only nonzero rep starts survive, decremented by1. Invisible outer entries remain in compacted levels but emit no offsets. Valid starts add one child; null/empty/masked starts add zero and bitmap false/true; rep0 continues child count. Truncate both vectors to local surviving starts.

Rep-only loop emits each nonzero start, compacts/decrements rep, counts every input as child, appends final tail and truncates to THIS unraveler write_idx, not cumulative destination lists. If another page required validity, append true for locally produced lists. This preserves nested multi-page reconstruction.

skip_validity delegates or debug-asserts all-valid then advances only current_layer. unravel_validity fast path for AllValidItem or missing defs appends original num_items true; otherwise increments def comparison and emits only levels whose mapped rep visibility is reached. Dense num_items is not updated by decimation/list compaction; outer all-valid layers should normally use composite skip path.

decimate rejects dimension0 as InvalidInput before sparse dispatch or buffer access. Dense with any rep vector hits todo panic for unsupported FSL/List combinations. Def-only compaction keeps indices0,dimension,2*dimension using unsafe bounds proof write<=read. No divisibility check and no num_items update; absent defs returns immediately.

Public CompositeRepDefUnraveler owns pages/chunks independently because meanings may differ. Crate compatibility checks add other composite trees; has_sparse and ensure_exhausted recurse into both. Dense exhaustion is not checked. Empty composite is constructible.

Private null_buffers_equal treats None as all-valid only against a present buffer of expected length with zero nulls; two present buffers require both expected lengths and bitwise logical equality. Two None compare true without length evidence. Composite decimate mutates each primary/comparison sequentially and propagates first error.

Composite unravel_validity skips all primary layers and returns None if every unraveler says all-valid. Otherwise builds concatenated bitmap using num_values only as initial capacity; it does not independently validate final primary length or drop a now-all-valid Some bitmap. Comparisons are consumed too and mismatch returns InvalidInput. FSL wrapper decimates then unravels validity.

Composite offsets checked-adds max list counts, optionally allocates bitmap, concatenates each unraveler and constructs Arrow OffsetBuffer. Capacity+1 remains unchecked; no-primary composite produces empty offsets and violates OffsetBuffer nonempty requirement. Comparison offsets and logical nulls must match or InvalidInput. Errors can follow partial mutation.

Public generic BinaryControlWordIterator fields are private. Specialized u8/u16 append methods zip rep/def, mask and pack rep above def, write little-endian bytes, then report raw rep==max_rep, raw def<=max_visible_def and raw def==0. Exhaustion returns None.

Binary u32 writes4 little-endian bytes with same flags. Public UnaryControlWordIterator privately holds one level iterator, mask, widths and max_rep. Semantic flags need consistent caller maxima/masks and source levels.

Unary u8 masks byte output but computes flags from raw level, treating no-rep as new row and no-def as valid. Unary u16 instead unwraps next (PANICS at exhaustion), masks before flags and writes2 bytes. This differs from Option-returning behavior of other widths; local tests do not exercise unary16 exhaustion.

Unary u32 uses ? for exhaustion, masks then writes4 bytes and flags; normally u16 maxima make unary32 unreachable with consistent absent-side max0. Nilary emits len all-true descriptors and no bytes. Private get_mask computes (1<<width)-1 in u16; width16 is not guarded and exceeds shift-width assumptions.

Private SpecificBinary alias fixes zipped copied u16 slice iterators, avoiding boxing per value. Public ControlWordIterator contains binary/unary8/16/32 and Nilary variants. Public ControlWordDesc fields report row-start, visible-slot and valid-item separately.

ControlWordIterator dispatches append and reports repetition presence, bytes0/1/2/4 and rep/def bits. append documentation says returns true but actual signature is Option<ControlWordDesc>. Binary variants report repetition present even if inconsistent supplied max_rep is0.

build_control_word_iterator takes buffers, inclusive maxima, visibility threshold and nilary length. log_2_ceil here means inclusive bit length (e.g.256 needs9), not mathematical ceil(log2(256)). Zero total bits returns Nilary even when buffers contain all-zero entries, ensuring decoder and writer agree on zero bytes. (rust/lance-core/src/utils/bit.rs:78-109)

Two present buffers select binary word by summed widths<=8,<=16,otherwise32. Zip stops at shorter slice; explicit len is unused and mismatched lengths are not rejected. Masks/maxima come from caller, not inferred or checked.

Rep-only uses rep mask and records total supplied width as bits_rep with bits_def0. Caller must provide max_def0 when def absent; inconsistent maxima can choose unnecessarily wide or mismatching layout. Unary16 exhaustion remains panic.
Def-only similarly uses def mask and total width as bits_def with max_rep forced0. Both absent always returns Nilary(len), even if supplied maxima nonzero. No validation of presence, count or maxima.

Public Copy/Clone ControlWordParser has BOTH8/16/32(shift,mask), REP8/16/32, DEF8/16/32 and NIL. Private paired parse reads1/2/4 little-endian bytes, shifts/masks and appends u16s. Slice indexing requires sufficient bytes;32-bit results cast/truncate to u16. Parser does not advance source.

Paired descriptor parsing computes row-start/visibility/validity without appending.32-bit branch casts rep/def for row/visibility comparisons but tests original def==0; malformed high bits can produce differences from parsed truncated levels. Width/shift/level consistency are caller preconditions.

Single-side parsing appends whole byte/word cast to u16 without bit masking. Rep descriptors always visible/valid and compare max_rep; def descriptors always new-row/visible and test zero.32-bit unary descriptor comparisons truncate to u16. No corruption Result boundary.
bytes_per_word is0/1/2/4. Public parse appends only sides represented by variant, NIL no-ops. has_rep matches BOTH or REP variants. Caller must advance byte position and enforce valid framing.
Public parse_desc dispatches flag readers; NIL returns all flags true even with empty source. This interprets a single word and does not check level ranges or source consumption.

Parser new sums u8 widths, chooses1/2/4 bytes and presence variant; both widths0 returns NIL. BOTH uses u16 get_mask cast to u32. No check for overflow of total_bits, widths exceeding16, shift>=word bits, or totals>32. Private local WordSize enum only selects byte group.

Test imports include sparse planning. Three max-visible cases assert no-list full sum, nullable leaf under list and nullable struct above list. Small validity and i32/i64 offset helpers build Arrow fixtures. All tests in this file were read only, not executed.

Sparse sibling mismatch fixture compares no nulls against null position0 and requires InvalidInput plus message. Empty offsets[0] must serialize with neither rep nor def buffer; test does not verify meaning order or decode zero-row list.

Basic two-list test asserts exact11 rep/def entries, nine leaf validity bits and reconstructed inner/outer offsets and nulls. Parent masking can normalize child validity rather than preserving redundant input bitmap bits.

Single null-list and empty-list fixtures yield identical levels with different meanings (NullableList versus EmptyableList). Assertion checks exact buffers and metadata, demonstrating meanings are essential to interpretation.

Trailing-empty regression asserts special tail preserved. Abnormal nonempty-null offset fixture normalizes offsets and manually supplies reduced child count5 instead of8; test does not assert the boolean garbage return.
Nested FSL dimensions2x2 with parent and leaf nulls assert eight defs, no reps, leaf mask and successive FSL validity reconstruction. Some parent-null child bitmap bits normalize false.

Zero-dimension decoder regression expects InvalidInput and positive-integer message after consuming leaf layer. Second nested FSL test uses all-valid leaf and confirms composite skips those layers before recovering parent validity.
Sliced offsets starting5 rebase to zero with five leaf values and expected rep/def. Two nested nullable/emptyable list fixture asserts exact8 entries spanning both list levels.
Empty-but-nonnull list reconstruction yields None validity with required defs. Fully valid nested list case has rep-only buffer and reconstructs both offset layers.
Single versus two-builder nested-list test compares repetition buffers for identical logical3-row data. This tests encoding concatenation, not decoding two independent nested unravelers.

Tests named only_empty_lists and only_null_lists include six ordinary leaf values as well as zero-length slots; they are not all-empty/all-null datasets. They assert exact levels and offsets; list bitmap distinguishes null case.

Combined null/empty slots require two list definition levels and separate bitmap states. Nullable struct inside null/empty list test verifies leaf masking, parent struct validity and list reconstruction.
Manually constructed rep/def checks nullable struct+leaf inside all-valid list. Definition-only three-layer fixture asserts parent masking and all-valid outer layer omission.

Composite page fixture concatenates a nullable-list page and an all-valid-list page, checking rebased8-list offsets and combined validity. Caller num_values9 differs from total14 on all-valid leaf skip path, illustrating capacity/count parameter is not always validated.

Two input builders with different null presence produce same exact nested level vectors as basic fixture. All-valid NullBuffer canonicalization must match add_no_null in meanings and visibility, with absent buffers.

Slicer test asserts12/40/12 bytes for5/20/rest visible values including boundary specials. Variable named def_slicer is accidentally created using rep_slicer, so this test checks repetition twice and does not directly instantiate def_slicer.

Nested test_control_words::check derives maxima and presence, checks widths/bytes, appends num_vals then expects None, compares exact bytes and parser roundtrip. Uses expected byte length for nilary len; exercised positive-data cases use buffer iteration rather than that length.
Control-word fixtures cover binary4+4bits→1byte,4+5→2bytes, unary4bit rep/def and empty nilary. No binary32/unary16/unary32 roundtrip case is present here.

Def-only five all-zero levels must select NIL, emit five new/visible descriptors and no bytes, then stop; NIL parser appends no buffers from empty source. Regression avoids writer1-byte/reader0-byte divergence after page splitting.

Rep-only and both-present five all-zero buffers also require zero-byte iterator with exact descriptor count/exhaustion. Tests are defensive for repetition normally beginning with nonzero schema maximum.

Nested test_control_words_rep_index::check asserts row-start and visibility at max_visible_def2. Cases cover paired, rep-only, def-only and nilary; it does not compare parser.parse_desc results or is_valid_item.
Null structs wrapping three null lists with zero leaf values serialize rep[1,1,1],def[1,2,1]; reconstruction verifies list bitmap and outer struct bitmap independently.
Nested-list trailing null regression preserves both null levels while only one leaf is present; reconstructs both offsets and masks.

Mixed-page tests combine def-present and absent pages for primitive validity, then combine nullable-item/emptyable-list with all-valid-item/nullable-list interpretations. Exact concatenated validity, offsets and list masks asserted.

Last regression covers nullable metadata with absent def buffer on an all-valid page combined with a nullable page. No local budget-planner tests, boundary width16 masks, unary16 exhaustion, malformed dense buffers, empty composite offsets, mixed list/FSL decimation or transactional-error tests are present; broader caller test coverage remains pending.
